# BRAINLLM

> Web framework built for LLMs. One `.brain` file = one component (HTML + BrainScript + CSS). `brain` (Rust) compiles it to direct DOM, no virtual DOM. Before writing app code, read the installed compiler's `brain spec`; it is the implemented contract. Raw SPEC.md also contains explicitly planned sections.

## Start an app
1. Read [README.md](README.md#give-your-agent-its-first-task) for setup and prerequisites: Git, Rust stable, Node 22+, and Chrome for browser checks on macOS/Linux.
2. Install from a separate checkout: `git clone https://github.com/chrisifm/BRAINLLM.git`, enter that checkout, then `cargo install --locked --path crates/brain-cli`. Ensure Cargo's bin directory is on PATH.
3. Run `brain new my-app` in the intended parent directory; enter the new app and read its AGENTS.md, `brain spec`, and `brain map --json`.
4. Implement a small complete workflow using generators and the supported syntax. Run `brain fix`, `brain check --json`, `brain doctor`, and `brain build`. Run `brain run` and inspect the actual app.
5. Report the preview URL, behavior checks and remaining failures. Close only temporary resources you own; retain a preview requested for review.

npm distribution is not published yet. Source installation uses the global `brain` directly; no `npm install` is required in the generated app for this workflow. The generated package manifest describes the future npm installation path.

## Docs
- [SPEC.md](SPEC.md): the whole contract, with a reference component. Also printed by `brain spec`.
- [examples/](examples/): valid apps and invalid cases with their expected error.
- [MIGRATION.md](docs/MIGRATION.md): incremental migration from React, Angular, Vue and Svelte, with parity tests.
- [EVOLUTION.md](docs/EVOLUTION.md): improve the compiler through isolated, tested proposals and reversible activation.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): framework invariants, verification and required maintainer review.

## Loop
`brain add` → edit → `brain fix` → `brain check --json` → resolve remaining diagnostics → `brain doctor` → `brain build` → inspect the app. MCP: `brain mcp`.
